## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, format, tests with coverage)
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that failed before; new behaviour has tests
- [ ] New user-visible strings exist in both languages
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.en.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No tokens, secrets, personal paths or real account data added
- [ ] Anything with a security impact is explained above
